rationale: Both parties agree that v31 always places `08-wasm` in `Deleted` and that the new app does not mount that key; the crux is whether the Cosmos upgrade loader rejects a deleted name absent from historical state. `app/upgrades.go:48-60` only forwards the list to `upgradetypes.UpgradeStoreLoader` and contains no such validation, while the cited local tests do not execute the loader, so the claimed load-time rejection—and therefore the upgrade halt—has not been proved; dismiss.
title: Delete the optional IBC Wasm store only when it exists
